source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'FACT_DATA_SRC_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'AGG_FACT_CAL' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'FACT') AS FACT_DATA_SRC_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'FACT_DATA_SRC_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'AGG_FACT_CAL' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'FACT') AS FACT_DATA_SRC_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'FACT_DATA_SRC_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'AGG_FACT_CAL' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'FACT') AS FACT_DATA_SRC_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'AGG_FACT_CAL' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'FACT_1') AS OLE_DB_Source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'AGG_FACT_CAL' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'FACT_1') AS OLE_DB_Source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'AGG_FACT_CAL' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'FACT_1') AS OLE_DB_Source_FilePath;

                        AND validentryflag = 0)

and odd_entry.rowvers + 1 = even_exit.rowvers) InnerTable
group by dw_agg_key"')

WITH myquery (dw_agg_key,iodatetime,rowvers)
     AS (SELECT dw_agg_key,
                        convert(datetime,( CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), iodate, 120) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, iotime, 108) )) AS iodatetime,
                Row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY dw_agg_key ORDER BY (CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),iodate, 120) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, iotime, 108)) ASC) rowvers
         FROM   [dbo].[FACT]
         WHERE  DW_RUN_KEY = 100
                        AND validentryflag = 0)                  
select DW_AGG_KEY,
CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(SECOND, SUM(CASE WHEN ISDATE(TimeDiff) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND, '00:00:00', TimeDiff) END), '19000101'), 8) NetTime
from (select odd_entry.dw_agg_key,even_exit.iodatetime - odd_entry.iodatetime TimeDiff
from myquery odd_entry
inner join myquery even_exit
on  odd_entry.rowvers % 2 = 1
and even_exit.rowvers % 2 = 0
and odd_entry.dw_agg_key = even_exit.dw_agg_key
and odd_entry.rowvers + 1 = even_exit.rowvers) InnerTable
group by dw_agg_key
